item.title: US and Israel launch a major attack on Iran. Trump urges Iranians to ‘take over’
item.description: The U.S. and Israel launched a major attack on Iran on Saturday, and President Donald Trump urged the Iranian public to “seize control of your destiny” by rising up against the Islamic leadership that has ruled the nation since 1979. Iran retaliated by firing missiles and drones toward Israel and U.S. military bases in the region.

item.title: Net worth of Seattle-area households double U.S. median
item.description: You probably already know that the Seattle area has one of the highest median household incomes in the U.S.

item.title: Hornets beat Blazers 109-93 for their 4th straight win
item.description: Brandon Miller had 26 points and eight rebounds, and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Portland Trail Blazers 109-93 on Saturday for their fourth consecutive victory.

item.title: 2A State Opening Round Girls Basketball: Ridgefield hangs tough until end in loss to Fife
item.description: Though the Spudders lost to Fife 52-40, ending their season, Ridgefield put on display why it was such a tough matchup over the past month.

item.title: 3A State Round of 16 Boys Basketball: Prairie still headed to Dome after 59-53 loss to Mount Spokane
item.description: Prairie began this year’s Class 3A boys basketball state tournament with a long road trip against a tough opponent. But because of the Falcons’ success this year, that journey isn’t done.

item.title: 3A State Opening Round Girls Basketball: Fourth-quarter run allows Snohomish to pull away from Evergreen 52-39
item.description: Sienna Capelli scored eight points in a decisive 10-2 run to open the fourth quarter that allowed No. 2 Snohomish to pull away for a 52-39 win over Evergreen in a 3A State Opening Round game Saturday at North Creek High School.

item.title: 1A State Opening Round Girls Basketball: No. 16 seed King’s Way Christian clinches first dome trip
item.description: For the first time, King’s Way Christian girls basketball is headed to the Dome. The No. 16 seed Knights knocked off No. 9 Nooksack Valley 43-36 in the opening round of the Class 1A state tournament on Saturday.

item.title: 4A State Opening Round Girls Basketball: Union’s 51-43 victory sends Titans to 4A quarterfinals

item.title: 2A State Opening Round Boys Basketball: Columbia River returns to Yakima with 77-41 rout over Clover Park
item.description: Earning the No. 11 seed for the Class 2A state boys basketball tournament meant the Columbia River boys basketball team got to stay in Clark County for its opening round game against No. 14 Clover Park.
